BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH time_slots AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
      p_date::TIMESTAMPTZ + INTERVAL '9 hours',
      p_date::TIMESTAMPTZ + INTERVAL '17 hours',
      INTERVAL '30 minutes'
    ) AS slot
  )
  SELECT 
    ts.slot,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM appointments 
      WHERE doctor_id = p_doctor_id 
        AND appointment_date = ts.slot 
        AND status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed')
    ) AS is_available
  FROM time_slots ts
  ORDER BY ts.slot;
END;
